text: {"assertions":["An intermittent EOF error was found in crypto/tls/handshake.go that only occurred for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels.","The root cause was a config loader reading the wrong environment file during TLS handshake negotiation.","The fix made environment selection explicit and implemented fail-closed behavior on ambiguity in PR #3415 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-1.","The issue could be reproduced by opening many short-lived connections in a row.","The problem resulted in 67 duplicate rows being written to the system daily before it was fixed.","The covering test for the fix is in crypto/tls/handshake_test.go."]}
